### 1. 适配器实现

```typescript
// src/mcp/manager.ts:50-97
class MCPToolAdapter implements Tool {
  private client: MCPClient;
  private def: MCPToolDefinition;
  private serverName: string;

  // —— Tool 接口四方法 ——

  name(): string {
    return `mcp__${this.serverName}__${this.def.name}`;  // 命名空间化
  }

  description(): string {
    return this.def.description;  // 透传
  }

  inputSchema(): Record<string, unknown> {
    return this.def.inputSchema;  // 透传 JSON Schema
  }

  async execute(input: unknown, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<ToolResult> {
    // 委托给 MCPClient.callTool（JSON-RPC tools/call）
    const result = await this.client.callTool(
      this.def.name,
      input as Record<string, unknown>,
      signal,
    );
    // 拼接所有 text 内容块 → 统一输出格式
    const text = result.content
      .filter((c) => c.type === "text" && c.text)
      .map((c) => c.text!)
      .join("\n");

    return { output: text || "(无输出)", isError: result.isError };
  }
}
```

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Literal, Optional

AlertLevel = Literal["info", "warning", "critical", "exceeded"]


@dataclass
class QuotaCheckResult:
    level: AlertLevel
    message: str


class QuotaManager:
    # 级别顺序：用于判断是否升级
    _LEVEL_ORDER: tuple[AlertLevel, ...] = ("info", "warning", "critical", "exceeded")

    def __init__(self, cost_limit: float = 0.0) -> None:
        self.cost_limit = cost_limit
        # 已触发过的最高告警级别，避免重复告警
        self._last_alert_level: Optional[AlertLevel] = None

    def check(self, current_cost: float) -> Optional[QuotaCheckResult]:
        """检查是否超限，仅在级别升级时返回告警，避免重复"""
        if self.cost_limit <= 0:
            return None

        ratio = current_cost / self.cost_limit
        level: Optional[AlertLevel] = None

        if ratio >= 1.0:
            level = "exceeded"
        elif ratio >= 0.95:
            level = "critical"
        elif ratio >= 0.80:
            level = "warning"
        elif ratio >= 0.50:
            level = "info"

        if level is None:
            return None

        # 只在级别升级时触发
        last_idx = (
            self._LEVEL_ORDER.index(self._last_alert_level)
            if self._last_alert_level is not None
            else -1
        )
        current_idx = self._LEVEL_ORDER.index(level)

        if current_idx <= last_idx:
            return None

        self._last_alert_level = level

        percent = f"{ratio * 100:.0f}"
        cost_str = f"{current_cost:.4f}"
        limit_str = f"{self.cost_limit:.2f}"

        messages: dict[AlertLevel, str] = {
            "info": f"成本已达配额 {percent}%（${cost_str} / ${limit_str}）",
            "warning": f"⚠ 成本已达配额 {percent}%（${cost_str} / ${limit_str}），请注意控制用量",
            "critical": f"⚠ 成本已达配额 {percent}%（${cost_str} / ${limit_str}），即将超限！",
            "exceeded": f"成本已超出配额（${cost_str} / ${limit_str}），自动停止",
        }

        return QuotaCheckResult(level=level, message=messages[level])

    def reset_alert_level(self) -> None:
        """重置告警级别（对应 TS 的 resetAlertLevel）"""
        self._last_alert_level = None
